subject: stop guessing, paste an address
preheader: free signup, no card, 60 seconds to your first underwrite.
headline: Theory is fine. A real underwrite on a real address is better.
body: Most rental investors I talk to have read more about cap rate and DSCR than they've ever calculated on a real property. The reading is fine. The doing is what changes outcomes.
Pick any address right now. A listing you're considering. A property you already own. A neighbor's house, out of curiosity. Paste it at usetruecap.com. No card, no install, no spreadsheet. Free.

What you'll get in 60 seconds: cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, NOI, operating expense breakdown, 10-year projection, and a verdict — STRONG BUY / MAYBE / SKIP. You can tweak any assumption and watch the numbers update in real time.

If the analysis is wrong (it sometimes is — rent comps are imperfect, tax assessments vary), you'll know exactly which assumption to challenge. That's still a 30-minute spreadsheet collapsed into 60 seconds.
The thing that separates investors who buy good deals from investors who talk about good deals is the number of properties they've actually underwritten. The tool is free. Go use it.
signature_note: PS — if you run one and the verdict surprises you, hit reply and tell me what address. I read everything.
